selection.scope: Training partition; baseline usable; no flagged cross-partition measurement duplicate

rules.typical: Nearest global median fragment count in most frequent positive-intensity acquisition cohort; then nearest cohort median recorded base-peak intensity
rules.low_signal: Strictly below 1st-percentile recorded base-peak intensity in the same cohort, excluding boundary ties; nearest boundary, then nearest global median fragment count
rules.uncommon_adduct: Supplied [M+Li]+ by default (CLI override); nearest global median fragment count among eligible rows

figures_measure: intensity retention and observed spectra; not identification accuracy
